chunks: And none can bind as He will bind.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean that no one can bind Allah?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores Allah's absolute independence (Al-Ghani) and lack of need for any guarantor or enforcer, contrasting with human reliance on covenants. It reflects the divine attribute of being unbound by time, space, or obligation, affirming His unique sovereignty over all creation.
